exercise.title: Around the 5th
exercise.why: The tritone is a half step under Sol and the minor 6th a half step over it, so you can hear each of them as a 5th that is a little too small or a little too wide.

cells.text: Press Start below. The game plays Do and then a note a 4th, a tritone, a 5th or a 6th above it. Hum the second note back, then pick its name: TT for the tritone, m6 for the minor 6th.
